name: Dialpad
description: Dialpad is an AI-powered cloud communications platform providing business VoIP calling, video meetings, team messaging, and live AI call transcription with real-time sentiment analysis.
best_for: Sales teams, customer support centers, and modern hybrid companies wanting native AI call summaries and live coaching.
features: Dialpad Ai delivering real-time live call transcription and post-call AI summaries
Unified business phone calling, SMS text messaging, and HD video conferencing
Real-time sentiment analysis and live AI agent coaching during customer calls
Automated call routing, multi-level IVR auto-attendants, and call queuing
Deep bidirectional integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, and Google Workspace
Native softphone desktop and mobile applications with HD voice quality

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Unlimited calling in US/CA, SMS/MMS, and real-time AI transcription. The annual view shows $15 per user per month; the monthly view shows $27.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Adds CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot), 24/7 phone support, and global office locations. The annual view shows $25 per user per month; the monthly view shows $35.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: 100% uptime SLA, custom data retention, and dedicated account management.

pros: Native real-time AI call transcription and automated action-item extraction
Modern, fast desktop and mobile apps with clean user experience
Seamless softphone switching between desktop, mobile, and desk hardware
cons: Pro tier requires a 3-seat minimum to access advanced CRM integrations
International calling rates and non-US virtual phone numbers incur add-on fees
Video meetings cap participant count at 10 on the Standard tier

alternatives.name: RingCentral
alternatives.description: Enterprise unified business communications platform with extensive PBX depth.
alternatives.best_for: Established enterprises needing comprehensive PBX hardware and fax support

alternatives.name: KrispCall
alternatives.description: Virtual cloud phone system with global phone numbers in 100+ countries.
alternatives.best_for: Remote teams and international businesses needing affordable shared phone numbers

alternatives.name: Nextiva
alternatives.description: Cloud business VoIP phone system with integrated team collaboration and CRM.
alternatives.best_for: Mid-sized businesses wanting reliable customer service and unified VoIP calling
